steps: User logs in using valid credentials

modules.name: Product Listing
modules.description: View and manage product listings including sorting and filtering.

submodules.name: View Products
submodules.description: User can view all available products.

submodules.name: Sort Products
submodules.description: User can sort products by name and price.

modules.name: Cart
modules.description: Manage the shopping cart including adding and removing items.

submodules.name: Add Item to Cart
submodules.description: User can add items to the cart.

submodules.name: Remove Item from Cart
submodules.description: User can remove items from the cart.

submodules.name: View Cart Details
submodules.description: User can view details of items in the cart.

submodules.name: Cart Badge Update
submodules.description: Cart badge should update immediately upon adding/removing items.

modules.name: Checkout
modules.description: Process for checking out and placing orders.

submodules.name: Enter Shipping Information
submodules.description: User can enter shipping information including postal code.

submodules.name: Review Order Summary
submodules.description: User can review the order summary before placing the order.

submodules.name: Place Order
submodules.description: User can place the order after review.

submodules.name: Order Confirmation
submodules.description: User views order confirmation upon successful checkout.

submodules.name: Postal Code Validation
submodules.description: Ensure postal code format is validated (5 digits for US).

jiraContext.commentsSummary: Checkout must validate postal code format. Cart badge should update immediately when items are added or removed.
jiraContext.epicSummary: Scope for this sprint: Login, Product Listing, Cart, Checkout. Order history is out of scope.
developerTasks: Implement login page with fields, button, and error message.
Product listing with sort dropdown for name and price.
Implement shopping cart with add/remove functionality and display.
Checkout flow with shipping form and order summary.
